description: Source code for the STMicroelectronics IIS2ICLX 2-axis accelerometer sensor driver, including interrupt handling and trigger configuration.

methods.name: iis2iclx_enable_t_int
methods.description: Enables or disables temperature interrupt pin.

methods.name: iis2iclx_enable_xl_int
methods.description: Enables or disables accelerometer data ready interrupt pin.

methods.name: iis2iclx_trigger_set
methods.description: Links external trigger to data ready event.

methods.name: iis2iclx_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles data ready interrupts, reads status, and calls registered handlers.

methods.name: iis2iclx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts in own thread.

methods.name: iis2iclx_work_cb
methods.description: Work callback for handling interrupts in global thread.

methods.name: iis2iclx_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO and interrupt configuration for the sensor.
